aboutText: S.H Property Maintenance & Handyman Services has been proudly serving Preston and the greater Melbourne area for over 10 years. We specialise in all aspects of property maintenance, from minor repairs to major renovations. Our team is dedicated to providing reliable, high-quality workmanship for both residential and commercial clients. Trust us to keep your property in top condition.
servicesText: We provide a wide range of handyman and maintenance services tailored to your needs. From plumbing fixes to carpentry work, our skilled team handles it all with professionalism and care.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: We fix leaks, install fixtures, and handle all plumbing issues efficiently for your home.

services.title: Electrical Maintenance
services.desc: Our licensed electricians ensure safe and reliable electrical systems in your property.
